needs.text: set boundaries with mother-in-law
needs.context: 1. Start by setting boundaries with your mother-in-law. Let her know that you are not willing to tolerate her negative behavior, and if she continues to cause problems, you will have to take steps to limit your contact with her. 2. Work on developing your own sense of self-esteem and value. If you feel like your mother-in-law’s opinions carry too much weight, practice expressing your own point of view more strongly. 3. Create healthy boundaries with your mother. Try not to be defensive or take her criticisms to heart. Respond calmly and remind yourself that her anger is not about you personall
